test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four persons A, B, C and D completed a task in (2)/(3)h, (3)/(4)h, (4)/(5)h and (1)/(5)h respectively. Who among the following took the highest amount of time to complete the task?
solution:
**Given:**

Four persons A, B, C and D completed a task in (2)/(3)h, (3)/(4)h, (4)/(5)h and (1)/(5)h respectively.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ Time taken by A = (2)/(3) = 0.66h

⇒ Time taken by B = (3)/(4) = 0.75h

⇒ Time taken by C = (4)/(5) = 0.8h

⇒ Time taken by D = (1)/(5) = 0.2h

**∴ C took the highest amount of time to complete the task.**
